claim: Under the heading “Only if and even if”: “The remote vs open contrast is the same in combination with only and if as in the examples given in [33].”
evidence_summary: [41] has only if in [i] and even if in [ii–iii]. Page 751 goes on: “Even likewise has the same interpretation in the remote versions as in the open ones.”
finding: Read only and even. Every example contains if, and the sentence as printed leaves out even.
inference: Which items does the remote vs open comparison combine with if?

evidence.example: Page 750 [41] and the heading above it.
